symbols.name: prime source length
symbols.meaning: The ν-th prime source length, an odd prime that counts the positions along axis ν.
symbols.quote: Prime source lengths are distinct odd primes $s_\nu$, one for each axis $\nu$, chosen so that their product fills a fixed fraction of the padded box.

symbols.name: padded axis length
symbols.meaning: The ν-th padded axis length, a power of two that counts the positions along axis ν of the padded box.
symbols.quote:
Here $T_
u$, a power of two, is the $

symbols.name: window width
symbols.meaning: A fixed constant with 0 < η < 1/4 that sets the width of the window for the prime source lengths.
symbols.quote: where $\eta$, a fixed constant with $0<\eta<1/4$, sets the width of the window.

Distinct primes are pairwise coprime, so the $s_\nu$ supply axis lengths to the [Chinese-remainder map](chinese-remainder-map.md), which turns one cyclic convolution into a multidimensional one.
